name: Zee Entertainment Enterprises Limited
remarksWeb: The Company has issued and allotted 23,900 5% coupon, unsecured, unlisted Foreign Currency Convertible Bonds of USD 1000 each maturing in 10 years (FCCBs) on August 12, 2024. These FCCBs can be converted at the discretion of FCCBs holders in to 12467058 equity shares of Re. 1 each. Accordingly, as advised by NSE, the Company has inserted the relevant details of No. Of Shares Underlying Outstanding convertible securities in sheet named 'Other_Insti (Foreign)'. Consequently, no. of Shareholders in column 'III' of the 'shareholding pattern' sheet is increased by 3 shareholders.
